acceptance_signals: The exact human-admitted task record exists and a create-only task-start baseline is captured before any evidence write, temporary-root allocation, staging, or build.
Every pre-existing changed path is classified: existing .agentgov scope baselines are preservation-only inputs under the included baseline prefix, and .codex remains excluded and byte-identical.

Read-only preflight verifies the current distribution-input manifest and both persisted digests, one compatible retained local build backend, the current evidence-gated short-root helper API, and zero existing task-owned short roots; any deviation stops before allocation.
Exactly one verified short root receives exactly the current manifest-selected regular files with no links, unsafe paths, extras, or source-to-stage byte mismatches.

Exactly one offline no-isolation wheel build runs without retry, repair, alternate backend, dependency installation, or network access and emits at most one wheel; failure stops later artifact claims.

Artifact analysis records managed package and data payload parity, generated metadata separately, wheel identity, and the first deviation without exposing host paths, raw output, source contents, credentials, or process identities.

Before cleanup, the same noninteractive artifact driver writes the declared sanitized durable evidence file, computes its exact canonical SHA-256, creates the repository-relative evidence receipt, and calls remove_short_build_root_after_evidence without input, stdin, or TTY-dependent control flow.

The gated cleanup revalidates evidence, removes only the exact verified task root, returns a privacy-bounded success result, and a final read-only check finds zero task roots; any evidence or cleanup failure leaves the root for bounded recovery and records no success.
STATUS and the dated development log distinguish Codex-run validation, pending validation, incomplete work, authority limits, and the next product review without rewriting prior task outcomes.

Only the new task record and baseline, the new dated build-validation record, STATUS, and the new dated development log may change; all product code, helpers, manifests, schemas, tests, prior task records, prior evidence, local configuration, and other documentation remain byte-identical.
The declared focused and complete Python 3.11 tests, manifest check, task and repository governance checks, task JSON parse, final scope comparison, zero-root check, and diff whitespace check pass.

No second build, public CLI or installed-package change, external Agent, model, consumer form, credential access, Git mutation, commit, push, publication, release, deployment, or full governance journey occurs.

decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-5f4dac9a5f9244bb8c5b7cb7d252a0fd and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control.

requirement.summary: Perform one bounded offline artifact-driver replay from exactly the current persisted distribution-input manifest. Before allocation, require the manifest checker, retained local build prerequisites, current short-root helper identity, and zero pre-existing task roots to pass. Allocate exactly one verified short root, stage only manifest-selected current regular files, run exactly one no-isolation wheel build without retry or repair, and retain the root through artifact analysis. The same noninteractive driver writes sanitized durable evidence at the declared repository-relative path, computes its canonical SHA-256 identity, creates an explicit evidence receipt, invokes remove_short_build_root_after_evidence without reading stdin or branching on TTY state, and confirms the exact root is absent. Stop at the first deviation and do not change product code or prior evidence.

items: Any manifest, prerequisite, staging, build, artifact, evidence, receipt, cleanup, scope, or validation deviation stops the replay without repair or a second build.
The evidence file must be durable before receipt creation and gated cleanup; a premature or mismatched receipt must not remove the root.
The current dirty inventory contains legitimate local baseline evidence and local MCP configuration; broad prefixes grant no authority to alter predecessor baselines or .codex.
A one-off foreground driver is validation evidence only and does not create a supported public workflow or prove future repeated reliability.
The temporary root and wheel may remain after a gated failure; recovery may remove only the exact verified task-owned root after durable evidence and must not claim replay success.
